description:
Dear Client,

Based on the information you provided, your annual income is $85,000. For the purpose of calculating your federal income tax, the applicable tax brackets are as follows: earnings from $0 up to $9,875 are taxed at 10 %; earnings from $9,875 up to $40,125 are taxed at 12 %; earnings from $40,125 up to $85,525 are taxed at 22 %; and earnings from $85,525 up to $163,300 are taxed at 24 %. These rates will be applied to the portions of your income that fall within each respective range.
